protocol: Before/after/after/before separate processes per backend. Each process measures 32 alternating cached/full-context pairs after 3 excluded warmups. Reset and prefill outside warm one-token timing; staging, kernel submissions, cache appends, logits readback and synchronization included. Summary pools 64 cached samples per version/case; before/after summaries are not paired observations. Benchmark processes are serialized and run only after correctness jobs finish; the final CUDA regression suite runs four tests concurrently after measurements. First-use/JIT timings retained in raw reports; driver caches not cleared.
scope: Deterministic f32 GPT: batch 1, 2 layers, width 64, 4 heads, FFN 256, vocabulary 256, capacity 256. Separate longer-context run at capacity 1024. Identical model fixtures/tokens per matched configuration.
arithmetic: Before cached and full-context references: strict f32 matmuls and deterministic f32 tree reductions. After cached: same surrounding arithmetic with online f32 normalized attention; contexts of 128 or more tokens use 16 partial scans and stable log-sum-exp merging. Numerical equivalence uses tolerance.
limitations: Warm one-token latency, not whole-generation performance.
Small f32 GPT fixture; no vLLM/SGLang parity claim.
GPU desktop graphics and unrelated CPU activity remain running.
Wider heads use a scalar scan; tensor-core attention and dedicated prefill tiling are not implemented.
